semantics.scope: Owner, ordering, sequence, timestamp, filtering and pagination are unchanged.
semantics.deltaSnapshots: When prefixLen and integer counts are present, retain snapshotFields and only tool name declarations from newMessages. Full payloads remain durable and readable through full.
semantics.legacySnapshots: Return full snapshots unchanged: the existing positional prefix comparison still requires their complete messages.
semantics.malformedSnapshots: Return unchanged when the optimized representation cannot preserve the existing fold behavior. Do not repair data or turn failures into empty results.
semantics.composition: payload_types selects payload presence first; this projection applies only to included payloads.
